annotations.title: Free website audit: speed, SEO and accessibility

description: Free audit of any public website, for questions like "why is my website slow?", "check my site speed", "audit my website SEO" or, in Portuguese, "porque é que o meu website está lento?" and "auditoria ao meu website". Runs the Google PageSpeed Insights API (https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/get-started) on mobile and returns performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, Core Web Vitals, the issues that weigh most on the score, missing security headers and page weight. Takes 20 to 90 seconds. Only public http(s) addresses.

locale.description: Answer language: English (en) or European Portuguese (pt).
